The csv file Neuropathic_24.csv contains neuropathic pain diagnosis records in the form of tables of which the row represents different patients and the column represents different diagnostic labels.

Which cause-and-effect relationship is more likely?
A. L achilles problems causes L C4 radiculopathy
B. L C4 radiculopathy causes L achilles problems
C. No causal relationship exists
Please answer with A, B, or C.

content.text:
The data show no association between the two labels, so there is no evidence of a causal link between them.

A chi-square test of L achilles problems against L C4 radiculopathy across the 16,384 patients gives p ≈ 0.63. Achilles problems occur in about 2.7% of patients and C4 radiculopathy in about 20%.

ANSWER: C
